Change from the previous attempt: the `block` genre does not use `block` as its own element keyword — that word is reserved for the genre name on line 1. The generic element keyword the spec uses throughout (nodes/edges) is `node`, so each component is now declared with `node <id> "<label>"`. That also resolves the four "unknown endpoint" errors on the `edge` lines, since they were only unknown because the declarations above them had failed to parse. The four edges (poller→normalizer, healthprobe→normalizer, normalizer→buffer, buffer→exporter) are unchanged, matching the description exactly.
